accelerate_loaders.description: Accelerate tape loaders by short-circuiting loops.

autosave_settings.description: Automatically save current settings to config on exit.

beta128_48boot.description: Auto-boot TR-DOS when Beta128 enabled on 48K/TC2048.

bw_tv.description: Simulate a black and white television instead of colour.

cmos_z80.description: Emulate a CMOS Z80 CPU instead of NMOS.

competition_code.description: Numeric code written to RZX competition mode files.

competition_mode.description: Record RZX in competition mode (no pausing, speed limits).

confirm_actions.description: Prompt for confirmation of dangerous actions (e.g., reset).

detect_loader.description: Auto-detect and start tape loading routines.

disk_ask_merge.description: Prompt to confirm B-side disk merge.

disk_images.description: Disk images. Items must specify 'interface' (+3, beta128, plusd, didaktik80, disciple, opus), 'drive' (A, B, 1, etc.), and 'file'.

disk_try_merge.description: Merge B-side disk images: Never, With single-sided drives, or Always.

embed_snapshot.description: Embed snapshot at start of RZX recording (when starting from existing snapshot).

fastload.description: Speed up tape loading by skipping delays.

frame_rate.description: Frame rate ratio: Spectrum frames per real frame (e.g. 1 = 50fps, 2 = ~25fps).

fuller_box.description: Emulate Fuller Box AY sound/joystick interface.

graphics_filter.description: Graphics scaling/filter: normal, 2x, 2xsai, 3x, 4x, advmame2x, advmame3x, dotmatrix, half, halfskip, hq2x, hq3x, hq4x, super2xsai, supereagle, timex15x, timex2x, timextv, tv2x, tv3x, tv4x, paltv, paltv2x, paltv3x, paltv4x.

ide_images.description: IDE/CF images for various interfaces. Items must specify 'interface' (simple_ide, zxatasp, zxcf, zxmmc, divide, divmmc), 'channel' (master, slave, or 'cf' for zxcf/zxmmc), and 'file'.

issue2.description: Emulate an issue 2 keyboard (early Spectrum models).

joystick_2_output.description: Joystick 2 output type (same codes as above).

joystick_keyboard_output.description: Keyboard joystick output type (same codes as above).

keyboard_arrows_shifted.description: Treat arrow keys as shifted (like Spectrum+ keyboard).

late_timings.description: Emulate screen timings one T-state later than normal (observed on some real machines).

machine.description: ZX Spectrum machine type to emulate: 16, 48, 48_ntsc, 128, plus2, plus2a, plus3, 2048, 2068, ts2068, pentagon, pentagon512, pentagon1024, scorpion, se.

mdr_cartridge_len.description: Length of new Microdrive cartridge (blocks); clamped to 10–254.

mdr_random_len.description: Use random Microdrive cartridge length (~180 blocks).

melodik.description: Emulate Melodik AY interface (48K/16K machines only).

microdrives.description: Microdrive images for Interface 1. Items must specify 'number' (1–8) and 'file'.

mouse_swap_buttons.description: Swap left/right mouse buttons for Kempston mouse.

movie_compr.description: Movie compression: None, Lossless, or High.

movie_stop_after_rzx.description: Stop movie recording when RZX playback/recording ends.

pal_tv_use_tv2x_effect.description: Add TV scanlines to PAL-TV scalers.

peripheral_roms.description: Peripheral ROM overrides (by peripheral name). Items must specify 'peripheral' and 'file'.

phantom_typist_mode.description: Phantom typist keystroke mode: Auto, Keyword, Keystroke, Menu, Plus2A, Plus3.

plus3_detect_speedlock.description: Enable Speedlock detection (requires weak-sector data in image).

roms.description: Machine ROM overrides (by machine name). Items must specify 'machine' and 'file'.

rzx_autosaves.description: Automatically insert snapshots every 5s into RZX recordings.

rzx_file.description: RZX file to play or record to.

separation.description: AY stereo separation: None (mono), ACB, or ABC.

speaker_type.description: Speaker emulation type: TV, Beeper, or Unfiltered.

speed.description: Emulation speed as a percentage of real Spectrum speed (e.g., 100, 500).

stealth_multiface1.description: Enable stealth mode on Multiface One (invisible mode).

teletext_addr_1.description: Teletext packet server 1 hostname or IP.

teletext_addr_2.description: Teletext packet server 2 hostname or IP.

teletext_addr_3.description: Teletext packet server 3 hostname or IP.

teletext_addr_4.description: Teletext packet server 4 hostname or IP.

use_slt_traps.description: Enable .SLT trap instruction support for multi-load tapes.

use_tape_traps.description: Use ROM tape traps for faster loading (disabling may be needed for some TZX).

volume_ay.description: Relative volume for AY-3-8912 sound chip (0–100%).

volume_covox.description: Relative volume for Covox (0–100%); effective only when Covox interface enabled.

volume_specdrum.description: Relative volume for SpecDrum (0–100%); effective only when SpecDrum interface enabled.
